README closeout must retain all 56 canonical surfaces. Fields, Relations, Query, Admin Columns, Listings and Status retain only their explicitly certified bounded baseline PASS claims. Surface 7 Custom Tables remains ACTIVE / NOT PASS at the evidence-backed bounded runway indicator of 90%. The concrete adapter wave is promoted through PR #450 and the post-adapter exact-main audit is promoted through PR #454. That audit keeps managed-table execution blocked and authorizes only Runtime Composition Readiness V1: trusted production bootstrap/composition of the already-promoted persistence, metadata-probe, recovery-verification and Policy/confirmation facts, with no managed-table DDL dispatch. Managed-table physical DDL, R3/R4 execution, live row scans, Backup creation/restore side effects, migration jobs/leases, row CRUD/Data Source runtime, CT2/PT-D/CT3 runtime, external adoption, public mutation, RUNTIME_CERTIFIED, PRODUCT_PARITY_CERTIFIED, deployment and release remain separately gated.
